review_candidates.description: Company Description ABOUT IQ-EQ We’re a leading Investor Services group offering end-to-end services in administration, accounting, reporting, regulatory and compliance needs of the investment sector worldwide. We employ a global workforce of 6,500+ people across 24 jurisdictions and have assets under administration (AUA) exceeding US$857 billion. We work with 13 of the world’s top-15 private equity firms. Our services are underpinned by a Group-wide commitment to ESG and best-in-class technology including a global data platform and innovative proprietary tools supported by in-house experts. Above all, what makes us different is our people. Operating as trusted partners to our clients, we deliver intelligent solutions through a combination of technical expertise and strong relationships based on deep client understanding. We’re driven by our Group purpose, to power people and possibilities. Job Description THIS ROLE: This IT Support Engineer (Level 3) role is the top internal technical escalation resource, receiving complex tickets and project assignments through the service dispatcher and working closely with the Engineering Manager to ensure all work is completed within SLA. This role leads new client onboarding and infrastructure deployments, drives process documentation, and mentors junior engineers. Clear communication with the dispatcher on project timelines and escalation status is essential. What You Will Do You’ll manage escalated tickets and project assignments, ensuring clear communication with the dispatcher and resolution within SLA timelines. You’ll serve as the highest escalation point, diagnosing complex technical issues, identifying root causes, and improving processes and documentation. You’ll lead Microsoft 365 and cloud initiatives, including migrations, architecture (M365, Entra ID, Intune), and automation using PowerShell and Microsoft Graph. You’ll design, deploy, and support Cisco Meraki network solutions, including security, segmentation, VPNs, and advanced troubleshooting across client environments. You’ll lead client onboarding and project delivery, ensuring secure, reliable IT infrastructure while providing clear communication and aligning solutions with business and security goals. What We Offer Comprehensive remuneration: Competitive financial packages based upon market rates for your role, proportionate to your qualifications, level of experiences and skills profile Pension Scheme: Generous employer contribution with the ability to increase employee contributions Wellbeing: Additional social benefits such as medical insurance & life assurance, discounted gym memberships and the opportunity to engage with our local community via sports activities, charity programmes & environmental initiatives Flexible working: We recognise the value of working flexibly and enable our employees to enjoy an excellent work-life blend Support and development: We will ensure you have the right training, tools and development plan to grow and improve your skills every day. Qualifications ABOUT YOU: You have 5+ years of IT experience, preferably in an MSP/MSSP environment, with proven ability to manage complex workloads within a dispatcher-driven service model. You possess deep expertise in Microsoft 365 (E5, EMS E3), including Entra ID, Exchange Online, Intune, SharePoint, and Teams, with hands-on experience in environment buildouts and migrations. You have strong technical skills in PowerShell and Microsoft Graph API, along with solid networking knowledge (DNS, VLANs, NAT, VPN) and experience with Cisco Meraki platforms. You have experience supporting Windows 11, Windows Server (Azure and on-premises), macOS, and mobile device management via Intune, with strong attention to detail in documentation and time tracking. You demonstrate excellent communication skills and professionalism, with preferred certifications (e.g., Microsoft, Azure, Meraki, ITIL) and experience using tools such as ConnectWise, IT Glue, and MDR/SOC platforms. Additional Information OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment. There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee. Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 6,500+ employees - from 94 nationalities, across 24 countries - to each achieve their potential. Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced. We’re committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients’ sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

review_candidates.description: Cross Link Consulting Cross Link Consulting of North Augusta, SC is seeking to hire a full-time IT Support Engineer to be the trusted technical resource our customers need. This is a hands on, mid level IT support position focused primarily on remote technical support, software troubleshooting, Microsoft 365 administration, cybersecurity response, and resolving client technology issues. In this position, you will earn a salary of $40,000-$50,000/year , based on experience. We also offer a great company culture with excellent perks including healthcare benefits, flexible hours, independence, and training and continuing education . Our community needs humble, grateful, caring stewards who are driven to serve others . If you embody these values and are driven to help people with their technology challenges, then read on! About Cross Link At Cross Link Consulting, we don't fix computers, we serve people! We are a Managed Services Provider (MSP) offering IT support, cybersecurity, and strategic technology services to businesses and organizations across the Greater Augusta and Central Savannah River Area. Over the years we've built something more than outsourced IT - we've become "the friendly IT department down the hall." We believe our success comes from more than technical know-how; it comes from people who are called to serve others. Our team thrives when we put our clients first, solve problems with creativity, and protect people from risk with diligence. That's why we foster a company culture that values both professional excellence and personal calling. A Day in the Life as an IT Support Engineer As an IT Support Engineer at Cross Link, you will serve as one of our primary resources for incoming remote support requests. You will take ownership of issues from initial troubleshooting through resolution, escalation, or coordination with the appropriate vendor or team member. The client relationship built through each interaction is yours. That ownership is the core of what makes this role meaningful. A typical day runs wide: a printer down at one client site, a new employee to onboard and provision at another, and even a suspicious email forwarding rule flagged in Microsoft 365 that needs a judgment call before the end of the business day. You triage, prioritize, and execute because you know your craft. Alongside the reactive work, you carry a standing slate of scheduled responsibilities. Weekly software update cycles, monthly backup reviews, and recurring email security alert reviews are yours to own and keep consistent. Clients count on that consistency even when nothing feels urgent. A significant part of the client base operates in the accounting, legal, and public health verticals, which means the applications on their desktops are not always standard issue. Getting fluent in the professional tax, accounting, and practice management software these industries run on is part of becoming effective in this role. Security is woven into the day, not bolted on at the end. Reviewing endpoint protection alerts, investigating phishing reports, and responding to suspicious account activity in Microsoft 365 are regular touchpoints. Clients trust us to catch what they miss, and you'll play an important role in protecting them. Required Qualifications A serving mindset for client and team interactions Humility and a desire for the team to succeed Passion and drive to work hard, take ownership, and seek additional responsibility Good judgment and intuition with uncompromising integrity 2+ years of IT support experience Strong software troubleshooting and analytical problem solving skills High aptitude and demonstrated ability to manage and troubleshoot: Windows desktop and laptop environments (hardware and OS) Microsoft 365 administration (user accounts, Exchange, Teams, SharePoint) Entra ID / Azure AD (account management, conditional access, permissions) Endpoint security and EDR platforms Email security and phishing investigation Printer and peripheral troubleshooting VPN client configuration and connectivity troubleshooting User onboarding and offboarding workflows Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting clients in accounting, legal, or healthcare verticals Experience troubleshooting line of business applications Knowledge of cloud backup and disaster recovery solutions Experience with email security platforms and alert review workflows Experience mentoring or supporting less experienced technicians Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices at the SMB level Proficiency with remote monitoring and PSA/ticketing platforms Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, or Microsoft certifications are a plus but not required Work Schedule The typical schedule for this position is Monday through Friday from 8 am to 5 pm. Extended work hours may be required during busy seasons. This is primarily an in office position, although occasional travel to client sites throughout the CSRA is required. Please note: Because we focus on mentoring and discipleship, this is NOT a remote or work-from-home position. Why Join Cross Link? A culture where people matter more than machines Flexible hours and independence Healthcare benefits Continuing education opportunities Are you called to humbly serve others? Are you organized and reliable? Do you have excellent communication and customer service skills? Are you driven to protect others from cybersecurity threats and help your team shine? If so, you are made for such a place as this! If you are excited by how well this opportunity fits your skills and calling, then please take the time to put your best foot forward with our online application and questionnaire. It can be completed in as little as 10 minutes, but we encourage you to plan for extra time so that you aren't rushed and can answer each question fully and with personality. review_candidates.description: We are looking for an experienced Network Service Engineer with strong expertise in customer network service configuration to support the design, implementation, and optimization of network services. In this role, you will contribute to the scalability, reliability, and performance of network infrastructure while ensuring that service designs align with business goals and customer requirements. On site 4 days a week in Ottawa The Network Service Engineer will work closely with Commercial, Product, Sales Engineering, Customers, Network Engineering, and external contractor teams to provide technical guidance on network configurations, documentation, use cases, test cases, and service design improvements. This role acts as a Subject Matter Expert for network services and configurations within the service portfolio, helping ensure that implementation decisions, validation plans, and documentation meet program objectives. Key Responsibilities Network Design and Implementation Design and support Layer 2 and Layer 3 routing and switching solutions to improve traffic engineering and optimize network resource usage. Work with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and translate them into practical network solution designs. Develop strategies to help partner business units implement and manage network service architectures. Represent Network Engineering in the review of product change requests by assessing technical feasibility, documenting findings, and communicating potential impacts. Network Architecture and Optimization Support the planning and evolution of customer network architecture, with a specific focus on Layer 2 transparent networking. Identify opportunities to improve network performance and optimize customer data network services. Perform network assessments and recommend improvements to support network health, operational efficiency, and SLO/SLA reporting. Build and validate proposed network architectures in a lab environment, including documentation of test cases and performance metrics. Document and communicate network requirements to hardware and software development teams, particularly for customer-facing MEF 3.0 interfaces and networking design requirements for data processing equipment. Participate in internal and external design and system engineering reviews, contributing materials related to Network Engineering activities. Protocols and Standards Maintain strong knowledge of industry protocols and standards, including IPv4, IPv6, IS-IS, BGP, segment routing, and MPLS. Stay current on emerging segment routing technologies and apply relevant advancements to improve network capabilities. Troubleshooting and Problem Resolution Serve as a technical expert for complex network troubleshooting and incident resolution. Partner with Operations teams to diagnose and resolve network issues quickly, helping minimize service interruptions. Vendor and Solution Evaluation Assess new networking hardware, software, and solutions that support network strategy and growth plans. Work with vendors to understand product roadmaps and provide feedback on feature improvements. Documentation and Knowledge Sharing Create and maintain technical and training documentation, including network diagrams, configuration guides, and troubleshooting procedures for Product, Sales, and Sales Engineering teams. Prepare and deliver presentations, reference materials, and test strategies for network equipment, application deployment, and operations. Share knowledge with team members and mentor technical and customer-facing resources. Work with Network Engineers to develop and oversee product investigations, proofs of concept, service validation activities, and lab-based product demonstrations. Required Education And Experience 10+ years of experience in carrier and customer network design, operations, deployment, and support. Broad experience or exposure across network product design, development, verification, deployment, and support. Understanding of Metro Ethernet Forum standards and objectives as they relate to Carrier Ethernet Services. Strong knowledge of routing and switching protocols, including IPv4, IPv6, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, and MPLS. Hands-on experience with network test devices and reporting tools such as Ixia and Spirent. Experience with network automation and scripting using Python, Ansible, or similar tools. Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex network issues. Demonstrated leadership ability, including mentoring engineers and customer-facing resources. Strong understanding of security principles and practices related to network architecture. Proven experience in network design, architecture, and optimization. Professional certifications from Cisco, Juniper, Ciena, or equivalent are highly desirable. Comfortable leading meetings and communicating technical issues, risks, and trends to senior management and other stakeholders at the appropriate level of detail. Excellent verbal, written, presentation, interpersonal, and collaboration skills. Proven ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams and organizational boundaries to achieve shared goals. ,

review_candidates.title: Aerostat Operator I
review_candidates.description: Aerostat Operators provide Operations and Sustainment (O&S) support for the Persistent Surveillance Systems – Tethered (PSS-T) program in OCONUS site locations. PSS-T is comprised of former Persistent Ground Surveillance System (PGSS) and Persistent Threat Detection System (PTDS) programs. Position is contingent based upon availability and possible class dates. Updates to your application may be delayed. Essential Responsibilities: Aerostat Operators/User-level maintainers will participate in the overall, hands-on operation of the aerostat system including launch, in-flight, recovery, and moored activities. Candidates will perform all functions to operate the PGSS/PTDS, an aerostat mounted Intelligence, Surveillance, And Reconnaissance (ISR) platform, its Mobile Mooring Platform (MMP), Sensor Payload(s), communications and navigation systems as well as associated support equipment (Boom Lift, Forklift, All Terrain Vehicles (ATV's), and Electrical Power Generators). Candidate will perform User-level maintenance functions include performing hands-on Preventative Maintenance Checks and Services (PMCS), troubleshooting, removing and replacing Line Replaceable Units (LRUs), and removing and replacing payloads. Candidate must possess a diverse range of skills with the ability to quickly adapt to new situations. Tasks will be performed under direction of higher classified technicians and/or site personnel. Minimum Requirements: High school diploma or equivalent is required. Two-year Associate’s degree in a technical field from an accredited college can substitute for work experience. Must have an active Secret US Government Clearance or the ability to obtain a Secret clearance. Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain a Secret Clearance. Must have a valid U.S. passport with a minimum of one year remaining. Must have valid US Driver's license. Knowledge of and experience in the operations of hardware systems and components. Experience in fault detection, isolation, and correction of hardware systems and individual components. Ability to perform routine system maintenance and analysis functions including: hardware configurations; adding, removing and replacing hardware components; use of hardware and software diagnostic testing tools; reading of electronic circuit schematics; and repairing printed circuit boards. At least one (1) year previous Aerostat experience OR two (2) years of experience in the following areas may be substituted in lieu of aerostat experience: Electrical Maintenance Mechanic Possess at least two (2) year’s aerostat experience as an operator at the 20 series level or greater from Army MOS 35F (Intelligence Analyst), 35G (Geospatial Intelligence Imagery Analyst), 35H (Common Ground System Analyst), 96R (Ground Surveillance Systems Operator), 96U (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Operator), or military branch equivalent. Two years of hands-on experience in performing operations and maintenance tasks either on an AEROSTAT system or a related industry/military equivalent is required. review_candidates.title: Specialist Project Planner
review_candidates.description: Onboarding You To The Company At Nexans, our global vision is to electrify the future. In Power Transmission, this means delivering the world’s longest and most complex HV subsea and land cable systems to connect nations and drive the global energy transition. We deliver EPCI turnkey projects worldwide with industry-leading technology, equipment, and expertise to design, manufacture, install, and service critical energy infrastructure. CHOOSING NEXANS At Nexans, your work contributes directly to the global energy transition. We offer meaningful careers with purpose in an international environment where innovation, operational excellence, and collaboration drive everything we do. As part of our Power Transmission business group, you will contribute to some of the world’s most ambitious offshore and subsea infrastructure projects while working alongside highly skilled colleagues across multiple disciplines and countries. WELCOMING YOU TO THE TEAM You will join the Project Planning team within Power Transmission, reporting to the Project Tender and Execution Planning Manager and operationally to Project Managers and Project Directors within assigned projects and tenders. As Specialist Project Planner, you will act as a technical authority within the planning discipline, leading the most complex and strategic planning activities across projects and tenders. In addition to supporting project execution, you will provide functional leadership, mentoring, and guidance to Project Planners and Senior Project Planners, ensuring consistent application of planning standards and best practices across the organization. You will work closely with project teams, clients, subcontractors, manufacturing plants, installation teams, and other planning units within the global PWR-T organization. How You Make An Impact As Specialist Project Planner, you are responsible for driving excellence in project planning and scheduling across high-value and high-complexity projects, while supporting the continuous development of the planning discipline within Nexans. Your key responsibilities include: Strategic Planning & Tender Support Provide expert planning input to strategic and complex tenders, including schedule development, risk analysis, and financial considerations Review and clarify tender specifications to establish robust planning and control strategies Coordinate and review planning contributions across the planning team to ensure alignment and consistency Project Planning & Execution Develop and maintain baseline schedules for complex and strategic EPC/EPCI projects in line with contractual obligations, client expectations, and internal procedures Coordinate schedule updates with engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, installation, and project management stakeholders Maintain full understanding of project scope, critical paths, interfaces, and interdependencies Perform advanced schedule analyses, forecasting, resource assessments, and risk/opportunity evaluations Facilitate On-Time Delivery (OTD) processes and promote strong planning discipline within project teams Prepare internal and external progress reporting in accordance with project and client requirements Revise schedules and forecasts in response to scope changes, project developments, and emerging risks Technical Leadership & Discipline Development Mentor, coach, and support Project Planners and Senior Project Planners across the planning community Ensure consistency, quality, and best practice application in schedules developed by the planning team Act as escalation point and technical authority for complex planning and scheduling challenges Support Project Managers and Project Directors in resolving schedule-related issues Drive continuous improvement initiatives within planning methods, systems, standards, and tools Contribute to competence development, training programs, and capability building within the planning discipline YOUR STARTING POINT The best candidates may not meet every requirement, but the following background will help you succeed: University degree or equivalent relevant competence Expert-level competence within project planning and scheduling Typically more than 10 years of experience as Project Planner in relevant sectors such as offshore, energy, marine, infrastructure, or industrial projects Strong understanding of project management principles, technical execution, and project economics Extensive experience working in complex, multidisciplinary project organizations Advanced proficiency with Primavera P6, MS Project, Excel, and related planning tools Strong analytical, coordination, and problem-solving skills Proven ability to mentor, guide, and influence planning teams and stakeholders Excellent communication and presentation skills Fluent English, both written and spoken; Norwegian is considered an advantage Structured, proactive, and collaborative leadership approach What Success Looks Like In this role, you will: Deliver reliable and high-quality schedules for strategic and complex projects Ensure proactive planning follow-up and timely reporting across projects and tenders Strengthen planning discipline, competence, and consistency across the organization Support successful project delivery through expert planning leadership and collaboration Act as a trusted advisor and technical authority within the planning community Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence across project planning activities OUR GROWTH CULTURE Among our employees we share the same values — we are pioneers of the energy transition, dedicated to delivering the highest standards of performance, united to achieve our ambitious goals. At the individual level, our growth culture is built on trust, collaboration, and empowerment. We believe in giving our people autonomy while fostering teamwork, knowledge sharing, and continuous development across our global organization. Information at a Glance Position: Specialist Project Planner Function: Planning – Power Transmission Location: Oslo / Paris / Edinburgh / Other applicable locations Reporting Line: Project Tender and Execution Planning Manager Project Scope: EPC / EPCI / Offshore & Turnkey Projects Project Portfolio Size: 5–1200 MEUR Role Scope: Strategic projects, discipline leadership, and planning excellence

review_candidates.title: Site Construction Manager (CCGT Plant / Cogeneration Plant)_Eastern Region
review_candidates.description: Job Description At WSP, this role will be responsible for site-based supervision, coordination and follow-up of EPC construction works for a Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) / Cogeneration plant project. The Site Construction Manager will act as a key interface between the Client, EPC Contractor, WSP project team and discipline specialists to ensure that construction activities are executed safely, in accordance with the EPC Contract, approved drawings, specifications, quality requirements and project schedule. The role will drive EPC performance, monitor site progress, coordinate issue resolution, follow up on pending actions, support construction readiness and ensure timely escalation of risks, delays and non-compliances Responsibilities Lead site construction supervision and coordination for EPC works, ensuring that construction activities are executed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, EPC Contract requirements, project procedures and applicable codes and standards. Act as the day-to-day site interface with the Client, EPC Contractor and WSP project team for construction-related matters, including progress, priorities, constraints, site issues and action closure. Drive EPC Contractor performance by monitoring daily site activities, manpower, equipment deployment, material availability, work fronts and adherence to the approved construction schedule. Coordinate with the Client and EPC Contractor to ensure that the WSP scope of works is completed smoothly, with timely technical inputs, site responses, inspections, reporting and issue escalation. Monitor construction interfaces between civil, mechanical, electrical, I&C, commissioning and HSE teams, and drive closure of interface issues that may affect schedule, quality or safety. Review construction method statements, ITPs, work permits, risk assessments, lifting plans, temporary works and construction procedures, and coordinate comments with relevant discipline specialists. Participate in site progress meetings, construction coordination meetings, Client meetings, EPC meetings and project review meetings, and ensure that key actions are recorded, assigned and followed up to closure. Prepare and circulate minutes of meetings, action trackers, site observation reports and construction follow-up notes for meetings and site inspections attended. Coordinate with discipline engineers for resolution of RFIs/TQs, design clarifications, field changes, site instructions, inspection comments and technical constraints raised during construction. Support construction planning, sequencing and readiness reviews, including review of look-ahead schedules, critical path activities, work front availability and construction constraints. Monitor site quality and HSE compliance in coordination with dedicated QA/QC and HSE teams, and ensure that construction observations, NCRs, punch items and corrective actions are properly tracked and closed. Coordinate site communications with the Client and EPC Contractor, and support timely escalation of risks, delays, manpower shortfalls, material constraints and unresolved technical or contractual matters. Support mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning readiness, punch list closure and handover activities by ensuring construction completion status is properly verified and documented. Maintain construction action logs, issue registers, RFI/TQ trackers, site instruction logs, NCR/punch list trackers and other follow-up tools required to drive timely closure. Provide inputs to construction progress reports, including physical progress, critical activities, constraints, delay events, recovery measures, manpower trends and key decisions required. Support review of EPC Contractor invoices, progress claims and milestone submissions by confirming construction progress, site records and supporting evidence as required. Ensure construction documentation and handover records are complete, traceable and aligned with project requirements, including redlines, as-built inputs, completion dossiers and final closeout records. Qualifications Must have minimum Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical Engineering discipline from an internationally recognized University. Minimum 15 years’ relevant experience, including substantial site construction management experience on CCGT, cogeneration, thermal power or large industrial EPC projects, with at least 5 years in a Construction Manager/Site Construction Manager or equivalent leadership role. Professional registration/certification is preferred. Strong capability in site reporting, construction documentation, progress tracking, action management, MS Office, document control systems and relevant project controls tools is required. Experience in construction supervision of CCGT/cogeneration projects involving GT, ST, HRSG, generators, BOP systems, substations, cooling systems and major civil/structural works. Experience supporting mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning readiness, punch list closeout and handover dossier preparation. Prior experience in KSA or GCC power project sites and familiarity with regional Client, EPC Contractor and permitting requirements is an advantage. Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all. Work on landmark projects around the world and embrace opportunities to make an even bigger impact in the communities you care about. What if you could do the best work of your life and create a legacy for yourself? With us, you can. Apply today.

review_candidates.title: Senior Construction Project Manager - Excellence/PMO (F/H)
review_candidates.description: Akuo est un producteur français d’énergie renouvelable (éolien, solaire et stockage). Le Groupe est présent sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur : du développement à l’exploitation, en passant par le financement et la construction. À fin 2025, Akuo dispose d'une capacité totale en exploitation et en construction de 2,1 GW et d’un portefeuille de projets de plus de 10 GW. Avec plus de 450 collaborateurs, le Groupe, dont le siège social est à Paris, développe des projets dans plus d’une quinzaine de pays dans le monde, en Europe et en Amérique principalement. review_candidates.description: Actualités Avis & Communiqués Faits Divers Ma Région Guinée Forestière N'Zérékoré Offres d'Emploi Publireportage Societé SOS Villages d’Enfants recrute un agent de renforcement économique des familles à N’zérékoré Par admin 16 décembre 2015 Facebook Twitter Pinterest WhatsApp RECRUTEMENT POUR un Agent de Renforcement Economique des familles pour le Programme de Renforcement de la Famille N’Zérékoré SOS Villages d’Enfants Guinée est une organisation sociale non gouvernementale d’aide au développement qui s’engage depuis 1985 à satisfaire les besoins des enfants vulnérables. Les enfants sans soutien parental et ceux vivant dans des familles en difficulté sont au centre de notre action. L’organisation développe des programmes très variés (à Conakry, Kankan, N’Nzérékoré et Labé) dont les Villages d’enfants SOS, un Foyer des Jeunes, un centre social et des programmes de renforcement de la famille, des jardins d’enfants et des écoles. Voir plus Cartes des régions Alertes de nouvelles Actualités de Guinée Dans cette optique, nous cherchons un Agent de Renforcement Economique des familles pour le programme de renforcement de la famille à N’Zérékoré. L’agent de Renforcement Economique des familles prendra part à la mise en œuvre quotidienne du programme de renforcement de la famille. Il/elle sera responsable de l’évaluation de la situation économique des familles et soutiendra le processus du plan de développement des familles. Travaillant étroitement avec la communauté, l’Agent de Renforcement Economique fera le rapport et est sous la supervision du Coordinateur du Programme de Renforcement de la famille. familles, leaders communautaires, organisations de base, groupements/AVE&C Participer au suivi des progrès réalisés par les groupes d’épargne-crédit et les tuteurs/promoteurs d’AGR Documenter les remboursement par les bénéficiaires (via AVE&C et les groupes d’emprunt accédant aux fonds de l’IMF) et signaler tout dysfonctionnement Participer à la définition de mesures perfectionnement technique Vos Missions Analyser les pièces et les dispositions spécifiques pendant la phase d’appel d’offres en examinant la programmation des travaux, la détermination des "progress measurements", les variations et problématiques liées aux délais, aux coûts et aux paiements, ainsi que les procédures de réclamation; Assurer le suivi contractuel des chantiers majeurs en suivant les plannings, la remise et l’approbation des documents, les événements impactant l’exécution des travaux, ainsi que les demandes de prolongation de délais et de paiements supplémentaires; Assister également les directeurs d’exploitation études et travaux en répondant aux sollicitations des différentes parties prenantes internes concernant la gestion contractuelle pendant l’exécution des travaux; Réaliser l’analyse préalable des réclamations, rédige les mémoires et assure la production des justificatifs nécessaires au traitement des demandes. Diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieurs, avec une spécialisation en génie civil ou une formation généraliste, vous possédez de solides capacités d’analyse des dossiers et d’évaluation des risques. Doté(e) d’excellentes qualités rédactionnelles, vous disposez également de solides connaissances en gestion budgétaire, financière et économique. Diplomate et rigoureux(se), vous faites preuve d’un sens aigu du détail et d’un excellent esprit d’analyse. Rejoindre Sogea Maroc, C’est S’investir au sein d’une entreprise qui œuvre depuis plus d’un siècle pour développer des ouvrages et des infrastructures innovants atteignant un très haut niveau de performance ; Intégrer des équipes d’experts ; S’offrir de belles perspectives professionnelles. Rejoignez-nous et vivez une véritable aventure humaine !

review_candidates.title: Chief of Staff - WES Canada (Remote)
review_candidates.description: Title: Chief of Staff Department: WES Canada Managing Directors Office Reporting to: Managing Director, WES Canada Compensation: CAD127K - CAD163K Employment Type: Full Time Location: Remote - Canada (Candidates based in British Columbia, Alberta, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, Ontario, Nova Scotia or willing to relocate)   Who We Are:       World Education Services (WES) is a non-profit social enterprise that supports the educational, economic, and social inclusion of immigrants, refugees, and international students. For 50 years, WES has set the standard for international academic credential evaluation, supporting millions of people as they seek to achieve their academic and professional goals. Through decades of experience as a leader in global education, WES has developed a wide range of tools to pursue social impact at scale. From evaluating academic credentials to shaping policy, designing programs, and providing philanthropic funding, we partner with a diverse set of organizations, leaders, and networks to uplift individuals and drive systems change. Together with its partners, WES enables people to learn, work, and thrive in new places. For more information about WES, please visit our website at www.WES.org.         About the Opportunity::  The Chief of Staff serves as the Managing Director's trusted advisor and strategic partner, ensuring the effective operation of WES Canada and enabling the Managing Director and WES Canada leadership team to focus on strategic leadership. The role coordinates executive priorities, supports decision-making, facilitates cross-functional alignment, and monitors execution of key organizational commitments, enabling leaders across WES Canada to deliver against our strategic and organizational priorities and commitments. This role operates across a highly matrixed organization and requires strong organizational awareness, political acuity, sound judgment, and the ability to influence without direct authority. Accountability for functional strategies, operational delivery, and organizational outcomes remains with the appropriate executive and departmental leaders with the Chief of Staff leveraging trusted relationships, the ability to connect information, perspectives and priorities across teams, and a focused on a commitment to outcomes to support WES Canada in realizing its’ strategic and organizational priorities. What You'll Do:   Serve as a trusted advisor and strategic thought partner to the MD and leadership team by assessing competing priorities, monitoring emerging issues and organizational initiatives, identifying risks, dependencies, and strategic trade-offs, and providing objective analysis recommendations, and escalation support. Serve as an organizational integrator who works across the MD, Canada Leadership Team, Executive Team, WES Canada Board, and organizational departments to ensure the flow of strategic information, issues, decisions, and materials are effectively managed. Project manage WES Canada's inputs into Enterprise-level or global board/leadership reporting, in addition to WES Canada Board governance logistics and operations. Manage the MD's internal and external commitments, including coordinating Board and committee materials, reports, briefing materials, updates, meeting preparation or logistics, and follow-up in partnership with relevant leads, ensuring that materials requiring the MD’s review, input, or approval are planned and prepared in a timely manner. Oversee and support the development and execution of the MD's annual work plan and WES Canada’s strategic priorities, by coordinating cross functional planning, monitoring progress, reporting results, addressing barriers, and supporting leadership decision-making. Project manage and provide oversight to selected high-priority strategic initiatives, special projects, task forces, working groups, on behalf of the MD Oversee the operational work associated with executive reporting and dashboards by working with Finance, Strategy, and departmental leaders to consolidate performance information for executive decision-making and continuous improvement across accountable stakeholders. Manage the translation and support the integration of Enterprise-wide strategic priorities into Canada-specific execution plans (and vice versa — surface Canada-specific issues upward). Oversee departmental annual budget coordination within WES Canada and where shared services, shared costs, or cross-entity resource allocation exist (e.g., shared Communications, IT, or Finance functions spanning US/Canada). Ensure effective and timely communications from the MD, such as correspondence, announcements, presentations, talking points, speeches, and other communications, working in close coordination with Communications Department and relevant subject matter experts. Build and maintain trusted relationships with department and enterprise leaders to ensure the MD is informed of significant organizational, stakeholder, operational, and reputational matters. Attend, on behalf of the MD when delegated, selected internal and external meetings, briefings, and events; capturing key insights, coordinating next steps and ensuring briefing is given to all relevant individuals, including the MD, to advance agreed priorities. Provide people management, oversight, and mentorship for administrative staff that support WES Canada. Oversee and manage consultants, honorarium, and any other expenses related to activities covered through the WES Canada budget   Your Experience: Required A degree in business administration, public administration, nonprofit management, public policy, organizational leadership, or a related field, or an acceptable equivalent combination of education and experience. 8-10 years of relevant work experience with strong preference in strategy execution, executive advisory support, organizational leadership, project or program management, policy, or business operations. Exceptional project manager who thrives in a fast-paced environment, delivers high-quality work, is comfortable managing up, and enjoys juggling dynamic priorities involving complex cross-functional initiatives or executive priorities involving multiple senior stakeholders . Track record as an excellent problem-solver who enjoys taking on new challenges and demonstrates strong decision-making skills and judgement. Excellent verbal and written communication skills that convey complex information to a range of stakeholders in compelling formats, including via PowerPoint slides; with demonstrated experience preparing executive correspondence, Board materials, presentations, speeches, briefing notes, and decision papers. Experience developing and monitoring executive work plans, organizational priorities, dashboards, or key performance indicators. Demonstrated qualitative and quantitative analytical skills to assess situations, break down complex problems, identify strategic tradeoffs, and apply learnings in a larger context. Experience utilizing inclusive and participatory models for strategy development, planning, decision-making, and/or budgeting within organizations and/or with external partners. Good interpersonal skills, including tact, diplomacy, and flexibility, and demonstrated experience building trust and credibility with diverse stakeholder groups to achieve results. Ability to exercise independent judgment, manage multiple competing priorities, and work effectively under pressure with resilience, initiative, and a high level of ownership. Strong people management and supervision experience. Proficiency in oral and written French.   Desired Multisector experience is preferred. Experience utilizing frameworks and models for strategy development, scenario planning, organizational decision-making, performance measurement, and budgeting. Experience working in the public, nonprofit, social impact, regulatory, professional association, or private sectors, with familiarity across more than one sector considered an asset.   What We Offer: Joining our team at WES means embarking on a purpose-driven career with a global impact, where you contribute daily to making a tangible difference in the lives of people worldwide. You'll thrive in an employee-centric environment, with access to learning opportunities, pathways for personal and professional development, and recognition of your achievements. Our inclusive, mission-driven culture values employees and focuses on investing in our people through our culture, people framework, and programming while offering the flexibility of remote work options. Work-Life Harmony: We believe that success is all about maintaining balance. Enjoy the freedom of remote work and flexible scheduling, paired with generous time-off policies designed to assist you in maintaining a healthy equilibrium between your personal and professional commitments. Our comprehensive wellness programs and work environment are focused on fostering your well-being. Rewards and Recognition: Your dedication and achievements are the cornerstone of our success. We recognize the importance of valuing your hard work which is why we offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and tangible rewards to celebrate your contributions. Professional Growth and Development: We are committed to nurturing growth within our team, recognizing that growth is essential to providing opportunities for career advancement and ongoing professional development. To prioritize your learning and success, we invest in comprehensive training programs and offer tuition reimbursement opportunities. We promote a culture of continuous learning that empowers you to thrive and evolve in your career. Innovation and Impact: Engage in work that directly transforms lives and empowers individuals and communities by expanding access to global educational and professional pathways. Join us in fostering a culture that values innovation, embraces new approaches, and leverages transformation to implement and drive impactful change. Community and Connection: Our team is made up of individuals from different cultures and backgrounds who have varying perspectives and ideas. Our diverse workforce reflects the global community we serve, and we take pride in it. We are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and included. Experience the power of connection by participating in a range of activities, including employee-led resource groups, town halls, collaborative team events, meaningful volunteer opportunities, and initiatives that promote equity, celebrate diversity, and cultivate a strong sense of belonging within our organization.   Values: Opportunity - We open doors so people can build better futures. Inclusion - We become stronger, more creative, and more resilient when we embrace diversity. Equity - We uphold fairness and justice in our work and actions. Enterprising - We are resourceful, inventive, and driven.   Inclusive Recruitment Process: We welcome all applicants, irrespective of their experience perfectly fitting the job description, as we value diverse and innovative viewpoints. At our organization, individuals who thrive in a culture of continuous learning and inclusive teamwork excel. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply.   Our Commitment: World Education Services is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that reflects the rich tapestry of our communities, both in the US and Canada. This commitment is underscored by our unwavering dedication to providing equal opportunities to all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or genetics. This commitment extends to every aspect of employment, from recruitment and hiring to promotions, training, and benefits. We comply with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. For us, diversity goes beyond compliance - it's about embracing unique perspectives and cultivating an environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential.   If you require assistance and/or accommodation at any point during the recruitment process, please contact us at hiring@wes.org, we're here to support you. Our Talent Acquisition team is happy to work with you to find solutions that meet your needs. For more information about WES, please visit our website at   www.WES.org   This position is an existing vacancy and is currently open for hire.

review_candidates.title: Aerostat Operator II
review_candidates.description: Aerostat Operators provide Operations and Sustainment (O&S) support for the Persistent Surveillance Systems – Tethered (PSS-T) program in OCONUS site locations. PSS-T is comprised of former Persistent Ground Surveillance System (PGSS) and Persistent Threat Detection System (PTDS) programs. Essential Responsibilities: Aerostat Operators/User-level maintainers will participate in the overall, hands-on operation of the aerostat system including launch, in-flight, recovery, and moored activities. Candidates will perform all functions to operate the PGSS/PTDS, an aerostat mounted Intelligence, Surveillance, And Reconnaissance (ISR) platform, its Mobile Mooring Platform (MMP), Sensor Payload(s), communications and navigation systems as well as associated support equipment (Boom Lift, Forklift, All Terrain Vehicles (ATV's), and Electrical Power Generators). Additional responsibilities include performing analyses of system operations and candidates must have: Knowledge of and experience in the operations of hardware systems and components. Experience in fault detection, isolation, and correction of hardware systems and individual components. Ability to perform routine system maintenance and analysis functions including: hardware configurations; adding, removing and replacing hardware components; use of hardware and software diagnostic testing tools; reading of electronic circuit schematics; and repairing printed circuit boards. Candidate will perform User-level maintenance functions include performing hands-on Preventative Maintenance Checks and Services (PMCS), troubleshooting, removing and replacing Line Replaceable Units (LRUs), and removing and replacing payloads. Candidate must possess a diverse range of skills with the ability to quickly adapt to new situations. Tasks will be performed under direction of higher classified technicians and/or site personnel. Minimum Requirements: High school diploma or equivalent is required. Two-year Associate’s degree in a technical field from an accredited college can substitute for work experience. Must have an active Secret US Government Clearance. Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain a Secret Clearance. At least ONE (1) year previous Aerostat experience. Certified and school trained on 34M and 74K. Must have a valid U.S. passport with a minimum of one year remaining. Must have valid US Driver's license. Knowledge of and experience in the operations of hardware systems and components. Experience in fault detection, isolation, and correction of hardware systems and individual components. Ability to perform routine system maintenance and analysis functions including: hardware configurations; adding, removing and replacing hardware components; use of hardware and software diagnostic testing tools; reading of electronic circuit schematics; and repairing printed circuit boards. Physical Requirements: Requires the ability to regularly lift up to 50 lbs. Requires the ability to regularly climb extension ladders, roof ladder, stepladders, and stairs at least 10 times during shift. Requires the flexibility to bend/stoop, squat repetitive during shift. Requires the ability to regularly kneel repetitive for shift. Requires the ability to move in a 90-degree fashion on a repetitive basis for shift. Requires the ability to stretch/reach on a repetitive basis for shift. Requires the ability to walk extensively throughout the plant during shift. Requires the ability to interact with all clients in a professional and friendly manner despite periods of stress. Medical Requirements Successfully complete and pass the medical and dental examinations as required by Amentum and our customer for deployment to Iraq. Must maintain physical and dental requirements for the duration of the deployment. Working and Living Conditions: This position may be located in a war zone, in an environment with harsh and dangerous working and living conditions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee may regularly be exposed to extreme and austere desert-like environment. Temperatures can reach 120-130 degrees Fahrenheit/50-55 degrees Celsius during the summer months. Employees must be willing and able to perform regular job requirements in this austere, extreme environment, as well as willing and able to deploy to CENTCOM, EUCOM, and AFRICOM for extended periods. Work schedules are a minimum of 6 days per week and 10 hours per day, while some jobs have higher daily and weekly minimums. #TAMOD

We employ a global workforce of 6,500+ people across 24 jurisdictions and have assets under administration (AUA) exceeding US$857 billion. We work with 13 of the world’s top-15 private equity firms. Our services are underpinned by a Group-wide commitment to ESG and best-in-class technology including a global data platform and innovative proprietary tools supported by in-house experts. Above all, what makes us different is our people. Operating as trusted partners to our clients, we deliver intelligent solutions through a combination of technical expertise and strong relationships based on deep client understanding. We’re driven by our Group purpose, to power people and possibilities. Job Description THIS ROLE: This IT Support Engineer (Level 3) role is the top internal technical escalation resource, receiving complex tickets and project assignments through the service dispatcher and working closely with the Engineering Manager to ensure all work is completed within SLA. This role leads new client onboarding and infrastructure deployments, drives process documentation, and mentors junior engineers. Clear communication with the dispatcher on project timelines and escalation status is essential. What You Will Do You’ll manage escalated tickets and project assignments, ensuring clear communication with the dispatcher and resolution within SLA timelines. You’ll serve as the highest escalation point, diagnosing complex technical issues, identifying root causes, and improving processes and documentation. You’ll lead Microsoft 365 and cloud initiatives, including migrations, architecture (M365, Entra ID, Intune), and automation using PowerShell and Microsoft Graph. You’ll design, deploy, and support Cisco Meraki network solutions, including security, segmentation, VPNs, and advanced troubleshooting across client environments. You’ll lead client onboarding and project delivery, ensuring secure, reliable IT infrastructure while providing clear communication and aligning solutions with business and security goals. What We Offer Comprehensive remuneration: Competitive financial packages based upon market rates for your role, proportionate to your qualifications, level of experiences and skills profile Pension Scheme: Generous employer contribution with the ability to increase employee contributions Wellbeing: Additional social benefits such as medical insurance & life assurance, discounted gym memberships and the opportunity to engage with our local community via sports activities, charity programmes & environmental initiatives Flexible working: We recognise the value of working flexibly and enable our employees to enjoy an excellent work-life blend Support and development: We will ensure you have the right training, tools and development plan to grow and improve your skills every day. Qualifications ABOUT YOU: You have 5+ years of IT experience, preferably in an MSP/MSSP environment, with proven ability to manage complex workloads within a dispatcher-driven service model. You possess deep expertise in Microsoft 365 (E5, EMS E3), including Entra ID, Exchange Online, Intune, SharePoint, and Teams, with hands-on experience in environment buildouts and migrations. You have strong technical skills in PowerShell and Microsoft Graph API, along with solid networking knowledge (DNS, VLANs, NAT, VPN) and experience with Cisco Meraki platforms. You have experience supporting Windows 11, Windows Server (Azure and on-premises), macOS, and mobile device management via Intune, with strong attention to detail in documentation and time tracking. You demonstrate excellent communication skills and professionalism, with preferred certifications (e.g., Microsoft, Azure, Meraki, ITIL) and experience using tools such as ConnectWise, IT Glue, and MDR/SOC platforms. Additional Information OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment. There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee. Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 6,500+ employees - from 94 nationalities, across 24 countries - to each achieve their potential. Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced. We’re committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients’ sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

new_matches.description: Cross Link Consulting Cross Link Consulting of North Augusta, SC is seeking to hire a full-time IT Support Engineer to be the trusted technical resource our customers need. This is a hands on, mid level IT support position focused primarily on remote technical support, software troubleshooting, Microsoft 365 administration, cybersecurity response, and resolving client technology issues. In this position, you will earn a salary of $40,000-$50,000/year , based on experience. We also offer a great company culture with excellent perks including healthcare benefits, flexible hours, independence, and training and continuing education . Our community needs humble, grateful, caring stewards who are driven to serve others . If you embody these values and are driven to help people with their technology challenges, then read on! About Cross Link At Cross Link Consulting, we don't fix computers, we serve people! We are a Managed Services Provider (MSP) offering IT support, cybersecurity, and strategic technology services to businesses and organizations across the Greater Augusta and Central Savannah River Area. Over the years we've built something more than outsourced IT - we've become "the friendly IT department down the hall." We believe our success comes from more than technical know-how; it comes from people who are called to serve others. Our team thrives when we put our clients first, solve problems with creativity, and protect people from risk with diligence. That's why we foster a company culture that values both professional excellence and personal calling. A Day in the Life as an IT Support Engineer As an IT Support Engineer at Cross Link, you will serve as one of our primary resources for incoming remote support requests. You will take ownership of issues from initial troubleshooting through resolution, escalation, or coordination with the appropriate vendor or team member. The client relationship built through each interaction is yours. That ownership is the core of what makes this role meaningful. A typical day runs wide: a printer down at one client site, a new employee to onboard and provision at another, and even a suspicious email forwarding rule flagged in Microsoft 365 that needs a judgment call before the end of the business day. You triage, prioritize, and execute because you know your craft. Alongside the reactive work, you carry a standing slate of scheduled responsibilities. Weekly software update cycles, monthly backup reviews, and recurring email security alert reviews are yours to own and keep consistent. Clients count on that consistency even when nothing feels urgent. A significant part of the client base operates in the accounting, legal, and public health verticals, which means the applications on their desktops are not always standard issue. Getting fluent in the professional tax, accounting, and practice management software these industries run on is part of becoming effective in this role. Security is woven into the day, not bolted on at the end. Reviewing endpoint protection alerts, investigating phishing reports, and responding to suspicious account activity in Microsoft 365 are regular touchpoints. Clients trust us to catch what they miss, and you'll play an important role in protecting them. Required Qualifications A serving mindset for client and team interactions Humility and a desire for the team to succeed Passion and drive to work hard, take ownership, and seek additional responsibility Good judgment and intuition with uncompromising integrity 2+ years of IT support experience Strong software troubleshooting and analytical problem solving skills High aptitude and demonstrated ability to manage and troubleshoot: Windows desktop and laptop environments (hardware and OS) Microsoft 365 administration (user accounts, Exchange, Teams, SharePoint) Entra ID / Azure AD (account management, conditional access, permissions) Endpoint security and EDR platforms Email security and phishing investigation Printer and peripheral troubleshooting VPN client configuration and connectivity troubleshooting User onboarding and offboarding workflows Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting clients in accounting, legal, or healthcare verticals Experience troubleshooting line of business applications Knowledge of cloud backup and disaster recovery solutions Experience with email security platforms and alert review workflows Experience mentoring or supporting less experienced technicians Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices at the SMB level Proficiency with remote monitoring and PSA/ticketing platforms Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, or Microsoft certifications are a plus but not required Work Schedule The typical schedule for this position is Monday through Friday from 8 am to 5 pm. Extended work hours may be required during busy seasons. This is primarily an in office position, although occasional travel to client sites throughout the CSRA is required. Please note: Because we focus on mentoring and discipleship, this is NOT a remote or work-from-home position. Why Join Cross Link? A culture where people matter more than machines Flexible hours and independence Healthcare benefits Continuing education opportunities Are you called to humbly serve others? Are you organized and reliable? Do you have excellent communication and customer service skills? Are you driven to protect others from cybersecurity threats and help your team shine? If so, you are made for such a place as this! If you are excited by how well this opportunity fits your skills and calling, then please take the time to put your best foot forward with our online application and questionnaire. It can be completed in as little as 10 minutes, but we encourage you to plan for extra time so that you aren't rushed and can answer each question fully and with personality. Misión Del Cargo Brindar soporte técnico de primer nivel a los usuarios de la planta, asegurando la disponibilidad y correcto funcionamiento de los equipos, aplicaciones corporativas, impresoras y servicios de red durante la operación, incluyendo horarios fuera de jornada administrativa. Funciones Principales Brindar soporte informático a usuarios en equipos de escritorio y notebooks con sistema operativo Windows, además de crear y configurar perfiles de usuario bajo dominio corporativo. Instalar y configurar aplicaciones corporativas según las directrices del Analista de Soporte, realizar mantención de hardware y formateo de equipos Windows, además de configurar y brindar soporte al cliente de correo Outlook. Diagnosticar y resolver problemas de impresión, incluidas impresoras Bixolon, atender incidencias de red nivel N1 (conectividad, cableado, switches y puntos de red) y gestionar el escalamiento y seguimiento de incidentes con proveedores externos hasta su cierre. Documentar incidentes y las soluciones implementadas, contribuyendo a la continuidad operativa de la planta mediante soporte en turnos rotativos, incluidos fines de semana. Requisitos Técnicos Experiencia en soporte informático en entornos Windows, administración de perfiles de usuario bajo dominio corporativo e instalación de aplicaciones corporativas como FortiClient, OCS Inventory u otras similares. Experiencia en mantención de hardware, formateo de equipos Windows, configuración de Outlook y diagnóstico y resolución de problemas de impresión. Experiencia en escalamiento de incidentes con proveedores. Conocimientos de redes a nivel N1 (conectividad básica, diagnóstico de fallas). Conocimientos en visualización de herramientas de monitoreo de fallas tipo NOC. Formación Académica Técnico de nivel medio o superior en Informática, Telecomunicaciones o carrera afín. Certificaciones deseables (no excluyentes): soporte técnico, redes, o fabricante (ej. Fortinet NSE 1-2,). Requisitos Deseables Experiencia previa en el área frutícola o agroindustrial. Experiencia con impresoras Bixolon (etiquetado/trazabilidad). Conocimientos en continuidad operativa de sistemas informáticos unitec. Disponibilidad para trabajar en turnos rotativos y fines de semana, desempeñando funciones de manera presencial en planta procesadora. Capacidad para resolver problemas bajo presión, orientación al servicio, autonomía y proactividad, además de una comunicación efectiva para el escalamiento de incidentes y la elaboración de informes de entrega de turno. Residencia idealmente en Rancagua o sectores cercanos. Ofrecemos Un entorno laboral grato, junto con oportunidades permanentes de capacitación orientadas a potenciar tu desarrollo profesional y personal. En Ranco Cherries estamos comprometidos con la Ley de Inclusión Laboral (Ley N°21.015). Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to draft polished correspondence for a wide range of audiences. Confidence interacting with senior leadership, board members, major donors, and community leaders. Advanced proficiency with Google Workspace; experience with CRM systems, project management tools, expense management software, and virtual meeting platforms. Resourcefulness and ability to anticipate needs before they become issues. Preferred Skills Highly intelligent and quick to learn Unflappable under pressure Warm, professional, and service-oriented Proactive rather than reactive Detail-oriented without losing sight of the bigger picture Trustworthy, discreet, and dependable Motivated by supporting a mission-driven organization and helping senior leaders operate at their highest level If this role sounds like a good fit for you, please upload a cover letter with your resume indicating your interest. new_matches.description: Nous recherchons un(e) Tunnel Manager pour accompagner notre activité sur un de nos chantiers tunnels / microtunnels localisés en Afrique. Vous serez rattaché(e) au Directeur de projet ou au Responsable d’exploitation qui pilote l’activité travaux de la Zone. Vous rejoignez une équipe passionnée de travaux spécialisée d’une centaine de collaborateurs et composée d’ingénieurs travaux, de conducteurs de travaux, chefs de chantier, chef d’équipes, pilote de tunnelier, poseurs, techniciens polyvalents. Demain vous intervenez sur tous les aspects de mise en œuvre d’un projet : Lors de la préparation du chantier vous participez au choix des méthodes, aux besoins en main d'œuvre et matériel, aux plannings de réalisation. Vous établissez le budget prévisionnel du projet en collaboration avec la direction du projet ou la direction d'exploitation et réaliserez de façon mensuelle le contrôle budgétaire liées aux opérations de tunnels Vous représentez la Société BESSAC auprès des Maîtres d'Ouvrage, Maître d'œuvre, Bureaux de contrôle, Organismes et Entreprises co et sous-traitantes lors de réunions régulières ou au travers de rédactions. Vous assurez la gestion fonctionnelle des équipes tunnels et microtunnels, dans un souci permanent d’efficacité et de recherche de la performance collective. Vous veillez au bon avancement du creusement, au respect des contraintes techniques et budgétaires. Vous veillez au bon déploiement des différents plans de prévention sécurité et environnementales. C’est un programme challengeant qui vous attend ! Les équipes centrales telles que les services Exploitation, Services techniques, Juridique, RH, Finance vous accompagneront au besoin pour mener à bien vos missions. Les personnes qui occupent ce poste ont suivi des formations bac+2 à bac+5 en Génie civil, travaux publics, géotechnique idéalement avec une spécialisation en travaux souterrains (ECP, ENPC, ESTP, INSA, Polytech’, Ecole d’ingénieur) ou équivalent. Vous avez déjà travaillé dans des contextes de projets en SEP ou conception/réalisation. Vous avez une appétence pour les relations humaines et gérez une équipe projet pouvant être constituée de personnes provenant de l’entreprise, des partenaires, ou encore des personnes recrutées localement dans les pays où nous nous implantons… Notre activité étant fortement orientée vers l’international, l’anglais est requis. L’espagnol est un gros plus et toute autre langue la bienvenue. Forte de ses 50 ans d’existence, BESSAC réalise des travaux de tunnels et microtunnels destinés aux métros, aux ouvrages pour l’eau et l’assainissement ainsi qu’aux galeries techniques (gaz, câbles, chauffage urbain…) et conçoit et fabrique ses propres tunneliers. BESSAC est une filiale de SOLETANCHE BACHY et fait partie du Groupe VINCI Construction. Avec un chiffre d’affaires de près de 160 millions d'euros, 2/3 de son activité est réalisée à l'international avec des projets en cours notamment en Côte d’Ivoire, au Sénégal, au Canada, en Colombie, au Panama, en Arabie Saoudite… Plus de 300 collaborateurs directs contribuent aujourd’hui au développement de l’entreprise. L’expertise technique est reconnue de tous et fait de BESSAC un cadre idéal pour intégrer le monde des travaux souterrains. Un véritable esprit de famille règne chez BESSAC, porté par des équipes expérimentées, une forte ancienneté et des collaborateurs habitués à travailler ensemble, offrant ainsi un environnement où chacun peut se projeter et évoluer sereinement.

new_matches.title: Specialist Project Planner
new_matches.description: Onboarding You To The Company At Nexans, our global vision is to electrify the future. In Power Transmission, this means delivering the world’s longest and most complex HV subsea and land cable systems to connect nations and drive the global energy transition. We deliver EPCI turnkey projects worldwide with industry-leading technology, equipment, and expertise to design, manufacture, install, and service critical energy infrastructure. CHOOSING NEXANS At Nexans, your work contributes directly to the global energy transition. We offer meaningful careers with purpose in an international environment where innovation, operational excellence, and collaboration drive everything we do. As part of our Power Transmission business group, you will contribute to some of the world’s most ambitious offshore and subsea infrastructure projects while working alongside highly skilled colleagues across multiple disciplines and countries. WELCOMING YOU TO THE TEAM You will join the Project Planning team within Power Transmission, reporting to the Project Tender and Execution Planning Manager and operationally to Project Managers and Project Directors within assigned projects and tenders. As Specialist Project Planner, you will act as a technical authority within the planning discipline, leading the most complex and strategic planning activities across projects and tenders. In addition to supporting project execution, you will provide functional leadership, mentoring, and guidance to Project Planners and Senior Project Planners, ensuring consistent application of planning standards and best practices across the organization. You will work closely with project teams, clients, subcontractors, manufacturing plants, installation teams, and other planning units within the global PWR-T organization. How You Make An Impact As Specialist Project Planner, you are responsible for driving excellence in project planning and scheduling across high-value and high-complexity projects, while supporting the continuous development of the planning discipline within Nexans. Your key responsibilities include: Strategic Planning & Tender Support Provide expert planning input to strategic and complex tenders, including schedule development, risk analysis, and financial considerations Review and clarify tender specifications to establish robust planning and control strategies Coordinate and review planning contributions across the planning team to ensure alignment and consistency Project Planning & Execution Develop and maintain baseline schedules for complex and strategic EPC/EPCI projects in line with contractual obligations, client expectations, and internal procedures Coordinate schedule updates with engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, installation, and project management stakeholders Maintain full understanding of project scope, critical paths, interfaces, and interdependencies Perform advanced schedule analyses, forecasting, resource assessments, and risk/opportunity evaluations Facilitate On-Time Delivery (OTD) processes and promote strong planning discipline within project teams Prepare internal and external progress reporting in accordance with project and client requirements Revise schedules and forecasts in response to scope changes, project developments, and emerging risks Technical Leadership & Discipline Development Mentor, coach, and support Project Planners and Senior Project Planners across the planning community Ensure consistency, quality, and best practice application in schedules developed by the planning team Act as escalation point and technical authority for complex planning and scheduling challenges Support Project Managers and Project Directors in resolving schedule-related issues Drive continuous improvement initiatives within planning methods, systems, standards, and tools Contribute to competence development, training programs, and capability building within the planning discipline YOUR STARTING POINT The best candidates may not meet every requirement, but the following background will help you succeed: University degree or equivalent relevant competence Expert-level competence within project planning and scheduling Typically more than 10 years of experience as Project Planner in relevant sectors such as offshore, energy, marine, infrastructure, or industrial projects Strong understanding of project management principles, technical execution, and project economics Extensive experience working in complex, multidisciplinary project organizations Advanced proficiency with Primavera P6, MS Project, Excel, and related planning tools Strong analytical, coordination, and problem-solving skills Proven ability to mentor, guide, and influence planning teams and stakeholders Excellent communication and presentation skills Fluent English, both written and spoken; Norwegian is considered an advantage Structured, proactive, and collaborative leadership approach What Success Looks Like In this role, you will: Deliver reliable and high-quality schedules for strategic and complex projects Ensure proactive planning follow-up and timely reporting across projects and tenders Strengthen planning discipline, competence, and consistency across the organization Support successful project delivery through expert planning leadership and collaboration Act as a trusted advisor and technical authority within the planning community Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence across project planning activities OUR GROWTH CULTURE Among our employees we share the same values — we are pioneers of the energy transition, dedicated to delivering the highest standards of performance, united to achieve our ambitious goals. At the individual level, our growth culture is built on trust, collaboration, and empowerment. We believe in giving our people autonomy while fostering teamwork, knowledge sharing, and continuous development across our global organization. Information at a Glance Position: Specialist Project Planner Function: Planning – Power Transmission Location: Oslo / Paris / Edinburgh / Other applicable locations Reporting Line: Project Tender and Execution Planning Manager Project Scope: EPC / EPCI / Offshore & Turnkey Projects Project Portfolio Size: 5–1200 MEUR Role Scope: Strategic projects, discipline leadership, and planning excellence
